# UNTR.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp47,305.0 against Rp23,025.0 (expected total return 110.8%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: derated_compounder_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Heavy equipment & machinery distribution.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- The DCF adds Rp20,361bn of investments/associates at book (model.valuation.methods.dcf_fcff.investments; Rp5,930 per share, 12pct of the Rp170,680bn equity value) with no fact and no source anywhere in fund record or sour
- EV/EBITDA (configured 25pct) was dropped and the weight silently renormalised so the DCF carries 66.7pct and P/E 33.3pct (model.valuation.methods weights). That change lifts the base target from about Rp33.9k on a 50/50 
- The P/E leg applies 5.1475x to LTM net profit of Rp7,800.6bn, i.e. trough earnings, giving Rp11,695, 76.5pct below the DCF, and still carries 33pct weight. The commodity-cyclical card procyclical error number one is valu

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
